subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: After the resolver input is narrowed, should configured memory embeddings adopt provider transport’s private-network semantics: omitted grants exact configured-host trust, explicit false removes it, and explicit true permits broader private-network access?
rationale: The code path can be mechanically repaired, but the resulting endpoint reachability and upgrade behavior is an intentional SSRF policy choice that requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Approve shared semantics
options.body: Use one private-network trust contract across provider transport and configured memory embeddings after the resolver input is narrowed.

options.title: Add compatibility transition
options.body: Preserve existing exact-host private endpoint behavior until an explicit migration or strict-mode transition is approved.

options.title: Defer memory inheritance
options.body: Keep memory embeddings separate and leave the linked issue open pending a dedicated trust design.

recommendation.title: Approve shared semantics
recommendation.body: Use one private-network trust contract across provider transport and configured memory embeddings after the resolver input is narrowed.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored major original provider implementation and refactor commits and merged the feature into core.
